tagline: EKKI Water Technologies — 40+ Into the Golden Era
notes: ekkipumps.com redirects to ekkigroup.com. EKKI Group owns two product brands, EKKI (borehole submersibles, multistage, solar systems) and DECCAN (openwell, mini submersibles, monoblocs). Phase per series is inferred from typical power ratings where the brand page does not state it. Prices are retailer/dealer listings, not brand MRP; 6C and 8C bands come from a dealer's generic EKKI V6/V8 listings that do not name the series.
